name: Mux Manager
subtitle: SSH and tmux in your pocket
promotionalText: Your tmux workflow, wherever you are. Read terminal output with smart reflow, switch windows, and send commands without resizing your desktop terminal.
description:
Your tmux windows. Your phone. Your workflow.

Mux Manager is an SSH client for iPhone and iPad built around the tmux sessions already running on your computers. Connect to a host, choose a session, and open a window by name. Read output, check on a task, or send your next command from wherever you are.

READ WITHOUT RESIZING
Smart mode reflows terminal text for a smaller screen while preserving colors and text styles. Your remote window keeps its dimensions, so your desktop connection can keep its layout. Long lines, shell columns, and code wrap locally. Choose Original when you need the remote grid.

THREE WAYS TO VIEW
Use Smart for comfortable reading. Choose Original to preserve the remote terminal grid and scroll around it. Switch to Fit device when you want the remote window to match your screen. Pinch to adjust text size, scroll through history, and tap Live to return to the latest output.

YOUR WINDOWS, ORGANIZED
Browse sessions and windows by name. Create and rename them, switch between hosts, and disconnect without ending your remote tmux work. On iPad, use the sidebar alongside your terminal when space allows.

INPUT THAT WORKS ON A PHONE
Compose multiline commands before sending, or use direct keyboard input. Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Ctrl-C, arrows, and Enter are always close at hand. For recognizable zsh/bash prompts, Tab uses the remote shell’s completion and brings the result back to the native input box, without submitting the command or installing a helper. This screen-based feature is best effort; Direct Keys remains available for other prompts. Hide the keyboard when you need more room to read.

CONNECT YOUR WAY
Save connections, generate Ed25519 keys, or import supported OpenSSH keys. Connect directly or reach an inside host through a saved bastion. Verify host fingerprints separately for each connection. Connections and key metadata sync automatically through your private iCloud database; saved credentials use iCloud Keychain.

MADE FOR LONG-RUNNING WORK
Follow builds, review logs, and interact with terminal tools, including coding assistants already running in tmux. The optional Conversation view interprets recognizable Codex terminal output. No OpenAI API key is required.

Requires an SSH-accessible computer running tmux 3.2 or later. Smart reflow and Conversation view depend on the terminal content; use Original or Fit device for full-screen tools. Fit device changes the remote window size and can affect other clients. iOS may suspend SSH in the background; your remote tmux processes keep running.

Open source under the MIT license. Support is available through GitHub Issues.

Mux Manager is an independent app and is not affiliated with OpenAI or the tmux project.
